comment:
* A Drawable that wraps a bitmap and can be drawn with rounded corners. You can create a * RoundedBitmapDrawable from a file path, an input stream, or from a * {@link android.graphics.Bitmap} object. *

* Also see the {@link android.graphics.Bitmap} class, which handles the management and * transformation of raw bitmap graphics, and should be used when drawing to a * {@link android.graphics.Canvas}. *

variables.name: mBitmapWidth
variables.comment: These are scaled to match the target density.

methods.comment: * Returns the paint used to render this drawable.

methods.comment: * Returns the bitmap used by this drawable to render. May be null.

methods.name: public void setTargetDensity(@NonNull Canvas canvas)
methods.comment:
* Set the density scale at which this drawable will be rendered. This
     * method assumes the drawable will be rendered at the same density as the
     * specified canvas.
     *
     * @param canvas The Canvas from which the density scale must be obtained.
     *
     * @see android.graphics.Bitmap#setDensity(int)
     * @see android.graphics.Bitmap#getDensity()

* Set the density scale at which this drawable will be rendered.
     *

     *
     * @see android.graphics.Bitmap#setDensity(int)
     * @see android.graphics.Bitmap#getDensity()

methods.comment:
* Set the density at which this drawable will be rendered.

methods.name: public void setMipMap(boolean mipMap)
methods.comment:
* Enables or disables the mipmap hint for this drawable's bitmap.
     * See {@link Bitmap#setHasMipMap(boolean)} for more information.
     *
     * If the bitmap is null, or the current API version does not support setting a mipmap hint,
     * calling this method has no effect.
     *
     * @param mipMap True if the bitmap should use mipmaps, false otherwise.
     *
     * @see #hasMipMap()

methods.name: public boolean hasMipMap()
methods.comment:
* Indicates whether the mipmap hint is enabled on this drawable's bitmap.
     *
     * @return True if the mipmap hint is set, false otherwise. If the bitmap
     *         is null, this method always returns false.
     *
     * @see #setMipMap(boolean)

methods.name: public void setAntiAlias(boolean aa)
methods.comment:
* Enables or disables anti-aliasing for this drawable. Anti-aliasing affects
     * the edges of the bitmap only so it applies only when the drawable is rotated.
     *
     * @param aa True if the bitmap should be anti-aliased, false otherwise.
     *
     * @see #hasAntiAlias()

methods.name: public boolean hasAntiAlias()
methods.comment:
* Indicates whether anti-aliasing is enabled for this drawable.
     *
     * @return True if anti-aliasing is enabled, false otherwise.
     *
     * @see #setAntiAlias(boolean)
